## Void Deck 0.2.11

- Fixes the controller and settings buttons on a game's details page: they invert on hover and keyboard focus (solid ink circle, inverted glyph) instead of turning black on a black page.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v0.2.11.zip` from this release.
